brief:
Islamic University suspended in-person classes as Israeli strikes continued to claim lives across Gaza, Middle East Eye reported. Three security guards at the university were among seven people killed in the strikes earlier in the day, with the overall death toll rising to eight.

The university's decision reflects the intensifying security situation in Gaza as airstrikes persist in the territory.
dek: Islamic University suspends in-person classes as Gaza death toll rises to eight We have earlier reported that Israeli strikes killed seven people in Gaza, including three security guards at the Islamic University of Gaza earlier today.
title: Islamic University suspends classes as Gaza death toll reaches eight
